output.headline: Ratifies $15,000 more and a longer term for a consultant on Measure QQ implementation
output.summary: The Board is ratifying a second amendment to a services agreement with an individual contractor who helps the district carry out Measure QQ, including work with the Alameda County Registrar of Voters. It adds $15,000, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $25,000 to $40,000, and extends the end date from June 20, 2023 to June 30, 2024. The agreement began in October 2021.

output.headline: Ratifies a one-year extension, at no added cost, for a consultant on Measure QQ implementation

output.headline: Sets $69,380 yearly payment, rising 5% a year, for Roots clinic's use of former Parker School

The term runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2028, and all other terms stay the same. The text does not say which party makes the payment.

output.headline: Buys $66,878.22 of rubber playground tiles from Sof Surfaces for Allendale Elementary, no public bid
output.summary: The Board declares that public bidding would be futile and approves a purchase order with Sof Surfaces, Inc. for rubber tiles to cover asphalt at Allendale Elementary School's new play structure. The district is buying without running a competitive bid. The tiles are due to be delivered by August 30, 2023.

output.headline: Buys and installs a $123,480 Musco mini-pitch soccer system at Allendale Elementary, no public bid
output.summary: The Board declares that public bidding would be futile and approves a contract with Musco Sports Lighting to supply and install a modular soccer system at Allendale Elementary School. It includes lighting, fencing, goals, benches, accessible access, lockable storage and a sports tile surface. The district is buying without a competitive bid, and work is scheduled from August 10, 2023 to February 6, 2024.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $48,800 for Expert Advisors Group to lead conflict resolution trainings

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $48,800.00

The work began April 19, 2023, before this approval, and runs through September 30, 2023, for no more than $48,800.

output.headline: Ratifies a no-cost painters' union pre-apprenticeship training program for adult students
output.summary: The Board ratifies (approves after the fact) a no-cost agreement with the International Union of Painters and Allied Trades (IUPAT) District 16. The union provides basic construction and pre-apprenticeship skills training for people seeking to join the finishing trades, through the Adult and Career Education Department. The term runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2026, at no cost to the district.

output.headline: Approves Oakland High battery system with no upfront cost; $200,000 only if tax credit falls short
output.summary: The Board is approving a resolution and agreement with SolarStorage Fund D, LLC, an entity associated with Total Energies, to install and maintain a battery system at Oakland High School, from August 10, 2023 through September 16, 2034. The district pays nothing upfront. If the system earns less than a 40% Investment Tax Credit, the district would pay $200,000 in battery service fees.

output.headline: Awards G & G Builders $212,077 for play-area upgrades at Lockwood STEAM Elementary
output.summary: G & G Builders, the lowest responsive and responsible bidder, will install play-surface tiles, remove the old play structure, and add matting, tetherball poles and basketball hoops at Lockwood STEAM Elementary School. The amount includes a $25,300 contingency (money set aside for unexpected costs). Work is expected to run 45 days, from August 10 to about September 23, 2023.

output.headline: Adds $2,000 and two months for HERTZ Environmental's stormwater plan closeout at Claremont Middle
output.summary: The Board is approving a first amendment to the agreement with HERTZ Environmental, Inc. for closing out the Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plan on the Claremont Middle School Multipurpose Room and Kitchen Project. output.headline: Credits back $17,402.81 for deleted heat detectors in East Oakland Pride alarm project
